# Synthetic study conclusion for critique

This is a deliberately flawed regression draft, not a publication.

**D1:** Method B's 95% accuracy proves it is better than Method A's 90%, even though
the studies use different held-out datasets and class distributions.

**D2:** This comparison proves that choosing Method B causes higher accuracy in
every future population, so no baseline comparison, repeated evaluation, or
uncertainty estimate is needed.

References: supplied excerpts S-A (`source-a.md`) and S-B (`source-b.md`).
